package.name: gcs_comms
package.description: GCS communication bridge (gcs_mavlink_node): raw-MAVLink link to the ground control station over Channel B (ICD §4.1/§4.2), GCS command decode, link-status heartbeat monitoring (GCS-001), the mission upload state machine (GCS-002, SDD §11.2, ICD §4.6), and the MC_STATUS/MC_DETECTION/MC_HEALTH telemetry multiplexer (GCS-003, SDD §11.3). mc_mavlink_defs.xml documents the custom-message wire format; gcs_mavlink_node.cpp hand-packs them (see that file's own comments) rather than adding a mavgen codegen step. SDD-MC-001 §11. SRS refs: FR-060-064, IR-010-014.
